reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, this closes #1939 with the smallest possible change.

Swapping `metav1.ListOptions{}` for `a.ListOptions()` in both `clustercatalog.go` and `clusterextension.go` gives them the same `--resource` field selector and `--selector` label selector the other analyzers already use. Since the fake dynamic client ignores selectors, the selector-aware list reactor in `clusterextension_filters_test.go` is a nice way to pin it. CI is green at `02d6cc0`.

Good to merge.
